## About
Traeger Landscaping, LLC works out of 9823 Greentree St in San Antonio. We do landscape design and build, excavation, grading and retaining walls for homes and commercial properties around the San Antonio area.
We hold a 4.7 rating on Google from 35 reviews. One family wrote that our crew treated their place like our own, down to driving slow in and out. That's how we like to work.
We're open every day, weekends included, so give us a call when you're ready to talk about your yard or property.

## Services
- Landscape design: Planning and building outdoor spaces for your home or property.
- Excavation and grading: Site work to prepare and shape your property before building or planting.
- Retaining walls: Walls built to hold back soil and shape sloped yards.
